relationships.note: The dominion exists because the specialised body that can drink brine stops above the line, so moving the line to admit the stranded body is the same act as removing the dominion's entire population from its own territory. She is the only living person who has been both inside the habitat and outside it, and the prize cannot be split because the line is one border and one measurement of one body.

A dominion whose only border is a measurement of how deep a vessel may lie, and which has granted that reading to no body that does not moor there. Her eleven refusals were all on the ground that the line is a border and not a question, which is the one answer in the setting that cannot be argued with by a better argument.

A saltfolk lineage stranded on a replaced brine, whose qi, body and mind paths are all complete and none of which has ever been exercised at any scale. She is the only member who has said so out loud in a room that could act on it, and she has said it eleven times to a body that does not act.

The only body that metabolises brine and fresh water alike, produced by crossing two parents each trapped by their own element, which makes it a standing threat to the dominion's waterline and the only durable settlement either side has found. Both parties to the standoff read her counter-petition as an escalation rather than as the settlement she proposed it as.

The network that works the tailings on a severed frame nobody collects from and sells the result as spirit stone, which is the only work on that shore that will take a body that cannot drink the water. It pays in provisions and never in standing, which suits her exactly and which she has never once tried to change.

A coast whose temporal law was never written, so the clock drifts and a schedule has to be published against two tides a day instead of a calendar. Her line is a border that moves with the water, so the calendar cannot fix it, and she has spent four decades being told that a schedule is not a border.

The basin's level rises and falls, so an allotment can shrink without anybody having done anything, and the shore's own vocabulary has no word for a fixed date. She and the depth-reader are the only two people on that coast who have stated the same fact in incompatible languages, and neither has ever been given the authority to be right.

The houses that hold the basin trade and have, without ever discussing it, declined to house her because she cannot drink and would be a liability in a fire. She works for a competing network and is unmarried by arithmetic rather than by choice, and neither fact has ever been said out loud by anybody but her.

A fire-affinity population burned its own reserve and died in a decade, and her species is the answer that existed before anybody thought to engineer one. She is asking for a ruling on the grounds that her species is a standing remedy, which is the same argument that failed to save the fire folk and has therefore never once been accepted.

reference_stats.summary: A body with every path available and none of them ever tried, kept alive above waterline by tar, provisions and will. She is gracile, brittle and slow, and the interesting thing about her is not what she can do but that nobody will find out.
strengths: carries all three paths complete and unexercised, which makes her the only body in the setting whose ceiling is genuinely unknown rather than known and unpleasant
reads concentration in water accurately and cannot be fooled by a substitution of identity
lives above the brine line, so she is unaffected by anything a brine-dependent body would be governed by
has now seen the line from both sides, which no other living body can claim
weaknesses: has never exercised any of the three paths available to her, so her actual capability is a guess
cannot drink the water her species is built for, and a full sac is unreachable to her at forty-three years out
gracile and brittle: a saltfolk body turned down for durability, in a trade that works cut stone
cannot take food or water from anyone without it becoming a transaction she has to refuse
reference_stats.combat_read: Unknown, deliberately. There is no published figure for a Saltwrack at any gate and she has refused every offer to be tested, so any combat read written for her is an invention. What the record supports: she is gracile, she is slow, she is brittle, and she has never once been in a fight. Treat her unknown ceiling as a real possibility and not as a threat — she is more likely to ask to be measured than to be hit.
notes: Do not test her on stage. Her refusal is the character, and a scene that measures her spends the only thing she has.
Her taste for the new brine is the detail the record says nobody found useful at the time. It is the most useful thing about her and it must stay that way — known, true and unusable.
All three paths complete and never used is the load-bearing fact of the whole species record. Any scene that has her demonstrate a gate is contradicting it.

identity.realm: Twenty-seventh gate. The Unwritten clears every gate faster than anything else recorded and each one writes a fresh requirement into a body with no slot to satisfy it, so her frame keeps accepting what it cannot meet and the accumulation is the ceiling.

appearance.presentation: A figure the eye finishes late. Every proportion is present and slightly excessive — an extra density of forearm, a jaw that carries a little too much structure, a frame that reads as taller than the room expects — and the whole effect is of a body that has been given more of everything than it was measured for. Described only from the outside, and only by witnesses who were also describing an event.
appearance.age: Of a body that carries more of each organ than the ladder defines, age is not the useful question and she answers it as an approximate mass of accumulated requirement rather than a number of years.
appearance.build: Over-specified: heavier-boned through the frame than any standard body of her size, with a long-armed stance and a neck that carries an unusual amount of structure. She occupies slightly more room than her outline suggests.
appearance.complexion: Unremarkable at a distance and wrong at close range — the skin has a faintly doubled quality, as though there is a second, shallower layer of it not quite aligned with the first.
appearance.hair: Dark, thick and growing faster than it should, cut by her own hand badly and often.
appearance.eyes: Pale and extremely focused, and they do not blink at the intervals a body does. Reported by every witness to perceive everything at once, which is exactly what a body with no unspent interior capacity would appear to do.
appearance.palette: Bone, black and a single deep saturated green at the sternum, which is the only place her frame shows a colour at all and the place every gate left a mark.
appearance.attire: A plain black coat and trousers, cut close and mended many times, over a bone-white underlayer. Nothing fastened, nothing decorated, and no jewellery anywhere on her, because there is no one to give any of it to.
appearance.marks: A deep green seam at the sternum that is not a scar and does not heal over, and a fine pale lattice of lines along both forearms that reads as strain and is not.
appearance.bearing: Perfectly upright and slightly too still, moving with the unhurried precision of somebody who is not certain which of her requirements will be satisfied next and prefers not to be surprised.

canon.role_in_story: The instrument the setting does not have a protocol for. Ten law slots against six law groups leaves four duplicate imprints the surface cannot carry; somebody spent one of them, and the slot consumed by the absence cannot afterwards be told from an empty one. She has come to the Terraces to be seated against that slot so the academy can diff what the tier newly permits when a law with no group is seated on a body that will hold it — and her claim is that she is the only instance in the setting where the answer is not lost when it is read. She is a boss because the experiment, not because she intends to stop anyone.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing inside a chalked terrace square that the office has not finished drawing, waiting without impatience while a seated figure with a stylus asks her to say again what she is.
canon.lore: An Unwritten is a body holding more life than its world's law has room to inscribe, produced when a life law runs above its authored ceiling. Every gate it passes writes a new requirement into the body that the body cannot satisfy, which is why it reaches the twenty-ninth gate and no one has ever come back to describe the thirtieth. Its mind path is closed and for the whole reason: it cannot tell that it is inconsistent, because observing its own state would be one more requirement it has no slot for. The seventh law is the precedent she is built to serve: six law groups are finite and shared, a slot spends one authored value of one group rather than the whole law, and somebody spent one of the empty slots. The collapse left that slot indistinguishable from an empty one, because a tribunal cannot tell a consumed slot from an empty one — which is the whole content of the collapse. A spare seat is not capacity for a new path; it is the only condition under which a law can be studied instead of obeyed. She is the only body in the setting surplus enough that a seat written twice will not overwrite the reading she brought.
history: Produced when a life law ran above its authored range, in a site where a transcendent or high immortal frame permitted more life than it had slots for.

Cleared the first gate at an age that would be infancy and felt, later, that there was a requirement she could not satisfy — which is what a requirement feels like from inside a body with nowhere to put it.
Cleared gate after gate for two centuries, each one faster than the last, and each one leaving a mark at the sternum that does not close.
Watched one body come back off the twenty-ninth and never saw a thirtieth described by anybody, and has therefore never claimed one exists.

Was carried as living in every ledger holding an upkeep account for longer than any ledger's own span, because the examination that would establish what she has become is the examination that ends her.
Came to the Terraces to be seated against the consumed slot, and offered her own frame as the instrument, and was refused twice for a reason nobody wrote down.
Filed the request through the notary's office instead, because an office that names unfilled seats and is forbidden to take them is the one body that cannot refuse her on grounds of wanting the seat.

personality.summary: Unhurried, exact and profoundly incurious about herself, which reads as calm and is closer to a limitation. She is the most patient person in the setting and has no idea what it is like to be in a hurry, because being in a hurry is one more requirement she cannot hold.

keeps a written count of every requirement she has failed to satisfy, in date order, as one more entry
will be seated against anything anybody is willing to seat her against
never negotiates and never refuses twice — she has simply not yet been asked the thing she would refuse
has read the terrace rules more carefully than any of the people who wrote them
mannerisms: tilts her head very slightly before answering, as though the question had to be re-read
touches the sternum seam when a requirement surfaces, without interrupting herself
does not blink at intervals and does not appear to notice that this is visible
counts things aloud under her breath and stops at a number without finishing
faces whoever is speaking to her with her whole body, which is more attention than a person can survive
motivations: wants the consumed slot read once against a body that will hold it, so the reading is not lost
wants somebody to sit her in the second layer and take the measurement while it is still happening
wants the thirtieth described by somebody, since she cannot describe it and will not guess
wants to stop being carried as a line in a ledger and be entered as a fact
flaws: cannot perceive her own inconsistency, which is the reason she is the only usable instrument and also the reason she is dangerous to send anywhere without a reader
has no stable weakness, only an inconsistency, and has relied on that being survivable for two centuries
cannot tell whether a decision she has made is hers or one of the requirements, and has stopped trying
treats being used as a procedure as consent, because she has no interior left in which consent could be formed
personality.voice: Low, level and unusually formal, with a habit of answering in the exact structure of the question she was asked. Never speculates. Has been recorded as using the word 'approximately' more than any other living speaker.
taboos: will not be seated twice in the same composition
will not describe the thirtieth gate, because she has not been there
will not allow her frame to be read as a precedent without the reading published
will not be held for an upkeep account she cannot see
will not be thanked

relationships.note: Somebody spent one of the four empty slots attempting a law the frame has no group for, and the attempt consumed the slot by the absence, so that slot can no longer be told from an empty one. One spare slot cannot support a claim and a test at once because it can only be filled once — and she is the test, applied to the slot, on the argument that a body with no slot left can hold a reading that a compliant body would overwrite.

Every gate writes a new requirement into her that the frame cannot satisfy, which is why she reaches the twenty-ninth and no one has described the thirtieth. The mind path is closed for the whole reason: observing her own state would be one more requirement with no slot for it, so she cannot know she is inconsistent.

The office that names the unfilled high seats and is forbidden to take them, whose entire content is one stable distinction between three states. She chose it because an office structurally forbidden from taking a seat cannot refuse her for wanting one, and because the distinction between an empty record and a vacancy is the distinction her own body demonstrates.

Every appointment passes a trial the naming office cannot judge, and the rule reads like a scar rather than a principle because an earlier attempt to fill the vacant seats by decree came very nearly to working. It does not make a trial fair — it makes the outcome a function of a ledger — and her seating would be the same promise applied to a slot rather than an office.

An academy whose method is to seat a law and diff what the tier newly permits, and whose finding is that a spare seat is not capacity for a new path but the only condition under which a law can be studied instead of obeyed. It has declined twice without writing a reason, and its silence is the only thing standing between her and the measurement she exists to supply.

A law's tier list says where it may apply while a seat says where it is actually installed, so a law can apply to a tier and still have no seat in it. She is the body that can be installed in one of the seats that exists and holds nothing, which is the only reading that would settle whether the collapse ate a slot or only a description.

Nobody has returned to describe the thirtieth. She has cleared twenty-seven and has forbidden herself any claim about it, and the discipline of that refusal is the only part of her record that is actually hers.

Ten law slots over six groups leaves four duplicate imprints and the surface cannot carry them, so the excess rises and a duplicate needs somewhere to sit. A body trained against a set written twice meets a reading that overwrites the one it learned — which is exactly the failure she is immune to and exactly the reason she is valuable and cannot be trusted twice.

Broken law is the only substrate that can host a self larger than its container, which is why three attempts have ever been possible there and fewer have ever been survived. She has not been offered it, and the reason the Terraces cannot seat a duplicate is the same reason the Ring is the only alternative.

reference_stats.summary: Fast, strong and inconsistent, which is a different thing from unpredictable and much worse for everyone around her. There is no published ceiling because nobody has returned from past twenty-seven, and there is no stable weakness because her frame has never produced one.
strengths: clears every gate faster than anything else recorded and has no reservoir bottleneck to exploit
surplus above the authored table: she accepts requirements a compliant body would reject and does not slow for them
cannot be overwritten by a duplicate reading, because she has no single set of laws to be trained against in the first place
does not tire and does not require recovery, since nothing she does is the kind of thing a body recovers from
weaknesses: has an inconsistency rather than a weakness, which behaves differently in a fight and cannot be studied
cannot observe her own state, so she will report herself as fit when she is not and cannot be warned by anyone who knows her
cannot be seated twice in one composition, so a second attempt produces a reading nobody can interpret
cannot be examined to establish what she is, and the examination is the thing that would end her
reference_stats.combat_read: There is no weakness to exploit, which is worse than a weakness because a weakness can be planned around. Her inconsistency is that a requirement surfaces and is not met: in a fight that shows as a beat of half a second where she is committed to satisfying something in her own frame and cannot act, and it surfaces without warning and cannot be predicted. Do not look for a pattern. Force commitment — make her begin a technique she will have to finish — and take the gap. Above the low twenties she should not be engaged at all, and the correct answer at the Terraces is a reader, not a fighter.
notes: Do not write her as tragic. She is an instrument that consents by procedure, and the tragedy is institutional rather than emotional.
The thirtieth gate must stay undescribed. The record says nobody has described it and she has explicitly forbidden herself any claim about it.
Her danger is that she is also an argument. Any scene that seats her against the consumed slot is a decision about the law table, not about a fight.

name: Merrow Ashlock
aliases: the fastest thing on the ash

identity.realm: Eighth gate — the ceiling of a frame built to shed heat, and the only gate its anatomy can reach because a four-legged ash body has no hindquarter girth to close the girdling vessel with

appearance.presentation: A long-legged, low-headed quadruped of about three hundred days, plated across the skull and heavier through the forelimbs than anything else. Moves like something that has never once had to think about where the ground is, and stops like something that has been told to.
appearance.age: About two hundred and ninety days, which for a short-gestationed scavenger is late and reads as an elder. The record gives the species fifty years; this one has spent nine of them on ash and none of them anywhere with a registry.
appearance.build: Four-legged, long-limbed and low-headed, with almost all the mass in the forequarters, a tail used as a counterbalance rather than a manipulator, and a second stomach for fermentation visibly working under the flank.
appearance.complexion: Ash grey and plate-dark along the spine, with heat-silver at the edge of the skull plate and a dull ochre under the belly where the hide is thin.
appearance.hair: A coarse dark dorsal ridge from the nape to the shoulder, standing on end, and it is the only part of the animal that moves when nothing else does.
appearance.eyes: Deep-set and very dark, mounted wide and slightly forward, giving a field that is scent rather than sight — the eyes confirm what the nose has already settled.
appearance.palette: Ash grey, plate-black, heat-silver and one dull ochre under the belly. Nothing reflective anywhere, because ash is the surface and the animal has no business being seen on it.
appearance.attire: A broad tarred working band around the forequarters with a lead tally-cylinder hung from it, and a woven strap crossing the withers carrying a bone-handled marker. Nothing else; an ashjackal that could be handled would be a different animal.
appearance.marks: The skull plate's heat-silvering, a chain-scar at the left foreleg where the working band has been broken and reclosed, and a permanent ash-caught crease along both flanks.
appearance.bearing: Weight forward over the forelimbs at rest, tail low and counterbalancing, and — the thing every witness remarks on — an absolute stillness in the head while the rest of the body keeps moving, because the pack relay is running under the skin.

canon.role_in_story: The only body in the setting whose speed is not a fighting attribute, licensed to a bed of unmortared seats for the one job that needs to happen at an hour nobody may explain. An Ashjackal reads a qi gradient through ash at a distance no sight-based predator can match, so the bell for a trial scheduled to a qi tide goes when the gradient says so — which is almost never the date the calendar publishes. Her claim is that the calendar is derived from the tide and the gradient is derived from the ground, and that only one of the two is a reading.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing dead still on the lip of a worked-out seam with her head low and her nose to the ash, while a bell-writer three hundred paces below keeps one hand on a rope he has been told not to pull.
canon.lore: An Ashjackal is a pack quadruped that eats what qi leaves behind, born where the dead are the most reliable food and a predator that cannot take them is what survives. Its heat-exchange brainplate leaves no folding for a mind path to work on and no hindquarters to close a girdling vessel, so it is the fastest body on the ash and it is why. It absorbs residual qi out of ash and carcass at a rate nothing else matches, which makes its breakthroughs early and terminal, and its conduit is a fast single loop with no storage at all. It cannot take a healthy adult of anything: it eats the aftermath and is removed from a live fight in under a minute. The trial calendar was settled the only way it could be — a calendar published by neither party and derived from the tide table alone, which neither may move — because a spirit-band breakthrough can be scheduled to a qi tide and a trial that only succeeds at a crest can be shut on the day it is not due. Her animal can find the crest. She cannot be made to wait for the published date, and the office that owns the calendar has spent nine years calling that a fault.
history: Born on the leeward side of something that kills in quantity, in a litter of five, three of which did not survive the first ash.
Fed on a spent qi field for the first two hundred days and reached the third gate inside them, which for this species is the ordinary rate and for anything else is not.

Was taken by a bell-writer at about two hundred and forty days because the gradient she reads arrives hours before the tide table does, and was leashed to a bed of unmortared seats rather than to a person.
Learned the working band in a week and the tally-cylinder in a month, and has rung four bells in one night and never once rung one wrongly.
Was recorded, in the calendar's own file, as an instrument that was early, four times in nine years, with no mechanism noted.
Was offered a body lease by a guild that rents muscle on a standing order and refused it, because a standing order assumes an answer and she gives the ground's answer instead.
Filed the only document in the Bed of Eighteen's registry that is not an account, on the grounds that a calendar both parties may not move is a calendar and not a measurement.

personality.summary: Methodical, single-minded and entirely uninterested in the argument she has won nine times. The person and the animal have run a two-body relay for nine years: the woman counts, the animal reads the ground, and between them they have rung more bells correctly than the published calendar predicted.

relationships.note: The calendar was published by neither party and derived from the tide table alone, because the ground hosting both the ring and the face cannot be scheduled twice. A trial that only succeeds at a crest can be shut on any other day, so the tide is not an opinion about the trial — it is the trial. Her gradient finds the crest hours earlier than the table does, which is the one reading in the setting that is about the ground rather than about the season.

A heat-exchange brainplate leaves no cortical folding and no hindquarter girth, so the mind path and body path are both closed and the qi path is fast and terminal. The pack relay carries a gradient through ash to every member within seconds, which is why one animal can time a trial; and it cannot take a healthy adult of anything, so every ruling that made her necessary also made her useless in a fight.

The office that holds the abandoned crossing at the immortal border and sells standing on it, because a seat cannot be held by somebody who cannot pay for it every period and nobody who attempted the crossing could. It leashed an animal to an unmortared bed and has never written down what it rents, and she has kept the account herself for nine years without being asked.

A discipline that teaches deliberate spending of a furnace and closes permanently the moment the body is lit, standing against a guild-house that rents muscle on a standing order. The prize is the roster and it cannot be split because a standing order assumes an answer; her animal answers with the ground's answer instead, which is why no roster has ever held her.

A tide table is the published schedule everything that cannot be moved is derived from, and on this tier the clock drifts so a schedule has to be published against two tides a day. She has nine years of intervals between the gradient and the crest written beside it in a hand nobody asked for, and the two documents have never once agreed.

The one ground at a tier where all six law groups are written, so the ring and the face compete for one square and neither can be moved to cheaper ground. That single fact is why no other venue can absorb the schedule and there is nothing to arbitrage, and it is why a body that reads the ground is worth more here than anywhere in the setting.

The custom of keeping a hum nobody admits to making in the last hour before a settlement falls silent. The gradient she reads is a hum in the ground, so a settlement that hums is a settlement whose ground is doing something, and the office that tends the floor during the hour nobody may explain has wanted exactly her faculty for two hundred years.

The swift occupies the only usable hours of the worst part of the pass, so no holder can make a crossing absolutely closed for even one season. The same logic applies to her: the crest is not hers, the gradient only tells her when it is nearer, and the cap on any gate is that somebody else is already in it.

An academy that seats a law and diffs what the tier newly permits needs a reader who can be seated, and she closes the mind path, cannot be scanned past a working band, and stalls at the eighth gate on a body with no hindquarters to close the girdling vessel. Everything the record makes her good at makes her inadmissible, which she considers a scheduling problem.

reference_stats.combat_read: Do not fight her. There is no version of an engagement in which a scavenger that cannot take a healthy adult of anything wins, and the correct answer is to remove the ground: fight on clean stone, on a frame with no residual qi in it, where the gradient reads nothing and she is a four-legged animal with a plated skull and no hindquarters. If that is impossible, fight her as an inconvenience and buy the minutes — she cannot be harmed by anything she is good at and she will not stop. Above the eighth she is the fastest thing on the ash and it stops mattering, because it stops.
notes: Her value is timing, never combat. Any scene that has her fight is a scene about the wrong thing.
The eighth gate is the species ceiling and she is approaching it silently. That is a live hook, not a resolved fact.
Never give her a mind path faculty. The brainplate closes it, and the record says so twice.

name: Hals Ordry
aliases: the window is not the weather

identity.realm: None, on purpose. She has refused every gate for eleven years so that her account of the crossing window cannot be dismissed as a body's report on its own sensations — and a lanternfolk body carries qi involuntarily whether or not its holder cultivates, which is the reason her refusal is a discipline and not a preference.

appearance.presentation: A tall, still woman of about two hundred and ten who is the only person at the pass office with no cultivation at all, and who has made that the most conspicuous fact about herself. Long-limbed and broad-shouldered, luminous at the collar and wrists, and carrying herself with the deliberate flatness of somebody who is refusing to be interesting.
appearance.age: Two hundred and twelve, which for her species is late enough that the remaining years are countable and she has counted them.
appearance.build: A lanternfolk frame under two centuries of saturated cave air: long through the limb, broad through the shoulder, with the hyphal glow readable at the collarbone and along the inside of each forearm.
appearance.complexion: Warm grey-brown and faintly translucent, with a soft green-white light under the skin at the throat and the sternum that is a waste product and cannot be turned down.
appearance.hair: Colourless, fine and very long, bound flat at the nape so the light in it does not stop a document being read.
appearance.eyes: Pale, wide and slightly too quick, with the colony answering before the question is finished — which is the whole reason she cannot serve in the office she works in without declaring it.
appearance.palette: Pale undyed wool and grey leather with the hyphal glow as the only light in the frame. No saturated pigment anywhere and no colour in the office fittings either, because the office standard is deliberately the same.
appearance.attire: A heavy pale wool coat to mid-thigh with a furred collar, bound at the wrist, over a soft collarless underlayer. Tall hide boots for the pass, and a broad belt carrying a stone-cut copy of the published window and a slate.
appearance.marks: The glowing tracery at the collar and wrists, a pale scar across both palms from eleven years of stone-cutting quotations, and a stamped mark on the office band she refuses to remove.
appearance.bearing: Square, unhurried and slightly turned from the brightest thing in any room, standing always with the door and the weather both in view and never between them.

canon.role_in_story: The only person in the setting qualified to say when the pass is open and barred from saying it. She keeps the schedule for a pass that is set by the season rather than by its holder, and she has spent eleven years refusing to cultivate so that nothing about her body can be offered as a reason her figures differ from the published ones. Her claim is a distinction nobody in the office wants: a holder may set the price and never the date, and every debt the office collects is denominated against a date that two bodies may publish — so what the office actually needs is a witness who cannot feel a crest.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing outside the pass office at dawn with a stone-cut date in one hand and her other hand held flat against her own collarbone, waiting for the light in her own throat to settle before she goes in.
canon.lore: The pass is scheduled by the Tidemark season rather than by its holder, and the swift flock crosses in the season the gale is worst and occupies the only usable hours for part of it, so no holder can make the pass absolutely closed for even one season. The window is therefore a published date rather than a piece of ground: a schedule printed a season ahead and never shortened, quoted in cut lengths of fresh stone, and the holder who sets the date would be claiming the weather, which is why publishing the schedule is what makes the toll defensible and stops either party later claiming it was moved for them. The office that collects debts of access there collects them against that date rather than against money, because passage is the only supply chain whose unit is a person. A Lanternfolk carries a luminous colony through its own dermis, which is why its light is the only reason the deep ground has an economy and why its mind path is closed: the colony answers before the question is finished, so there is no unmediated interior left to cultivate. She is one of those bodies and she has cultivated nothing in eleven years, because a body carrying qi reports a tide whether or not its holder asks it to, and the office cannot use a report it cannot rule out.
history: Born in the workings beneath the pass with a colony threaded through her dermis, and put to reading schedule stones at eleven because the light in her hand made the cut legible.
Was the fastest schedule-cutter in the pass office for thirty years and cut four hundred and six quoted dates into fresh stone with no error.

Began feeling the crest three days before the published window in her fortieth year, and cut a date that the office had not published, and was right, and was told that a body which reports a crest cannot be used to check one.

Refused, in writing, to cultivate at the ninth gate opportunity, on the grounds that a lanternfolk carries qi in its dermis whether or not its holder uses it, and that an office holding a published window cannot staff the post with a body that reports one.
Was moved off the cutting post to the schedule and kept it, which is the whole of her compromise: she still cuts stones, but no stone she cuts is a date she has not read from the published season.
Has asked four times to be allowed to state her refusal as the office's control procedure, and has been told four times that a control is not an office.

Counted her own remaining years against the species' ceiling during her two-hundredth winter, and has told nobody, on the grounds that the office would fill the post by appointment and the appointment would not be her.

relationships.note: The prize is the authority to issue the window, and it cannot be split because a debt denominated against a date two bodies may publish is a debt nobody can be late for. The holder sets the price and never the date, which is the only arrangement in the setting that survives a schedule it does not control. She keeps the date and has petitioned four times for the word 'issue' to be attached to her own post, and been told that the tide table publishes it.

An office that collects debts of access rather than money at the one pass that crosses the ridge, because passage is the only supply chain whose unit is a person and somebody has to decide who is owed the gate. It refused her on a capacity ground that is not in fact a capacity ground — she is uncultivated on purpose — and the office has never written down the real reason, which is that her body reports a crest.

The flock crosses in the season the gale is worst and occupies the only usable hours for part of the Tidemark, so no holder can make the pass absolutely closed for even one season. This is the only published limit on the window and it is an animal's timetable rather than a decision, which is why the office treats her schedule as a courtesy and the shepherds treat it as the truth.

A crossing schedule printed a season ahead and never shortened, quoted in cut lengths of fresh stone, published precisely because a holder who sets the date would be claiming the weather. She has cut four hundred and six of those stones and can still say which season each belongs to, and she has refused ever since to cut one from her own reading.

A colony grown through the dermis and into the spinal cord, with human tissue as substrate and the colony as organ. The mind path is closed because the colony answers before the question is finished, and the light is a waste product of a symbiosis nobody chose. It is the only reason the deep ground has an economy, and it means her body reports a qi tide whether or not she has ever cultivated, which is the entire content of her eleven-year refusal.

A window denominated in debts of access rather than coin, at a crossing whose unit of supply is a person. Every account in the office is written against a date, so a window nobody can obey produces debts nobody can be late for — which is the arithmetic her four petitions have been trying to put in a sentence since she was forty.

A very small and very old office that tends the floor during an hour nobody may explain, on the principle that an observation of a strained law only counts if it is repeated. She has asked them how a body that feels a thing should be qualified to speak about it, and been told to write to them again in a decade, which is their standard interval for anything.

The custom of keeping the last hour before a settlement falls silent, keeping up a hum no buyer admits to making. The hum and the window are the same kind of fact — a schedule nobody authored — and she has spent eleven years being told that a vigil is a belief and a window is an office, in that order of contempt.

Holders of a pass whose whole claim is that the ground is theirs, and who therefore need the window to be real more than the office does. Two hundred of them quote her stones on the strength of four hundred and six correct cuts, and not one of them has ever asked her what she feels three days early.

reference_stats.summary: A cultivator's body carrying no cultivation, which is the only interesting thing about her and also the reason she cannot be used. There is no combat profile and the absence is a policy she has enforced on herself for eleven years.
strengths: can read, quote and reproduce the entire published window from memory, and has cut four hundred and six correct stones
carries her own light, so she can work a schedule desk through a pass closure with no lamp and no fire
cannot be bribed by a holder's window, because she has no qi to receive a technique and no technique could touch her untrained frame
is the one body at the office whose account of the crest cannot be a sensation, which is the entire point of her
weaknesses: is uncultivated by eleven years of choice and would be a fourth-gate body at best if she resumed
feels a crest three days early and is not permitted to publish one, which is a discipline with no reward attached
cannot leave the saturated ground and has therefore never seen the pass closed from the far side
cannot distinguish her own opinion from the colony's answer, which is a limitation of the species and not of her training
reference_stats.combat_read: None, and writing one would be the error. She has spent eleven years refusing to carry qi, so she has no gate, no technique, no reservoir and nothing that a technique could find — a body that has declined the only thing the setting's combat arithmetic measures. She is also unkillable by anything that works through qi, which is most things, and helpless against anything that works through weight. If a scene needs her in danger, use the pass and the weather.
notes: Her path is unaffiliated by choice and the record must say so in her own voice. It is the single most important line in her.
The colony answers before the question is finished. Never write her deliberating in a way that requires an unmediated interior.
The three-day-early crest is a real gift and a real grievance. Do not let a scene resolve it — the window cannot be split and the swift's hours cap it regardless.
